import itertools
g=np.arange(-2,2.01,0.5)
cols=[];labs=[]
for a in g:
    for b in g:
        for c in g:
            cols.append(x**a*v**b*t**c); labs.append((a,b,c))
F=np.array(cols)
y=dv_dt
bn=t*np.log(t)
Fp=F-np.outer(F@bn/(bn@bn),bn)
yp=y-bn*(bn@y)/(bn@bn)
G=Fp@Fp.T
b_=Fp@yp
n=len(cols)
ss=yp@yp
dg=np.diag(G)
best=[]
for i in range(n):
    det=dg[i]*dg-G[i,:]**2
    ok=np.abs(det)>1e-9*np.maximum(dg[i]*dg,1e-12)
    dd=np.where(ok,det,1.0)
    c1=(b_[i]*dg-G[i,:]*b_)/dd
    c2=(dg[i]*b_-G[i,:]*b_[i])/dd
    rss=ss-(c1*b_[i]+c2*b_)
    rss=np.where(ok,rss,np.inf)
    j=int(np.argmin(rss))
    best.append((float(rss[j]/ss),labs[i],labs[j],round(float(c1[j]),4),round(float(c2[j]),4)))
best.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
for z in best[:8]: print(z)
